in_arabic.name: هزرت
in_arabic.long_meaning: The Arabic name Hizrat means 'migration' or 'journey'. This name is significant in Islamic history as it refers to the migration of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his followers from Mecca to Medina, which is known as the Hijra. The Hijra marks the beginning of the Islamic calendar.
